run_write_top_k_vasp_cli: run the write_top_k_vasp script to generate VASP input files for the top k adsorbate-slab configurations from a cache
run_vasp_relaxation_inputs: run write_top_k_vasp with default flags to generate VASP relaxation input files for top k systems
run_vasp_single_point_inputs: run write_top_k_vasp with --sp flag to generate VASP single point input files instead of relaxations
review_VASP_FLAGS: review the VASP_FLAGS dictionary to understand default VASP calculation parameters like ibrion, nsw, encut, and xc functional
review_write_vasp_input_files: review the write_vasp_input_files function usage to understand how atoms and vasp_flags generate POSCAR, POTCAR, KPOINTS, and INCAR files
